skill.name: daedalus-skill
skill.description: Daedalus guides product discovery conversations for early ideas. It helps users create PRDs with scope, risks, competitors, boundaries, and tool recommendations.
skill.summary: Turn vague product ideas into scoped PRDs through guided conversation.
skill.author: sevenwoood

security_audit.summary: All static command, network, filesystem, blocker, metadata, and obfuscation findings were reviewed as false positives in Markdown documentation or passive image assets. I found no evidence of executable shell use, automated network calls, hidden file access, prompt injection, or data exfiltration intent. The PNG and SVG assets were manually reviewed as image content.

remediation.issue: Large SVG embeds raster data and triggered manual review.
remediation.suggestion: Replace the banner with an optimized PNG or a smaller SVG without embedded base64 data.

remediation.issue: Markdown inline code and fenced templates triggered command heuristics.
remediation.suggestion: Add brief notes that these are documentation examples and output templates, not executable scripts.

remediation.issue: Manual install paths under hidden home directories triggered filesystem heuristics.
remediation.suggestion: Clarify that these paths are user-selected install locations and the skill does not access them automatically.

static_findings.snippet: - **输出位置**:在对应轮次的反馈块中,用 `🔒 安全风险提醒` 标注。
- **输出模板**:见 `rules.md` 边界确认规则。
- **实现方式**:维护 `risk_reminded` 列表,每轮扫描用户新输入,若有未提醒的关键词则触发相应提示。
- **零代码工具表**:Canva、微信小程序云开发、[v0.dev](https://v0.dev/)、[bolt.new](https://bolt.new/)等,并附带白话解释。
├── flow.md                             # 对话流程总览(含 Mermaid 流程图)
- `likes_dislikes`:用户喜欢的/讨厌的产品与功能
- `threshold_choice`:用户选择的门槛路径(轻量/中等/完整)
- `must_haves`:用户列出的V1必须功能(最多3个)
> 建议你保存为 `.md` 文件,因为几乎所有AI工具(如[v0.dev](https://v0.dev/)、Cursor)都能直接读取。
- 打开 [v0.dev](https://v0.dev) 或 [bolt.new](https://bolt.new),粘贴本PRD中的“功能边界”和“设计原则”部分,让AI生成前端代码。
- 如果需要后端,注册 [Supabase](https://supabase.com) 免费账号,按照教程创建数据库。

content.value_statement: Early product ideas are often vague, hard to scope, and difficult to turn into next steps. Daedalus guides a structured conversation and produces a clear PRD with risks, boundaries, and tool recommendations.
actual_capabilities: Guides users through multi-round discovery questions for unclear product ideas.
Tracks idea summaries, user preferences, core value, scope choices, and risk reminders.
Evaluates technical, cost, time, and operational thresholds for early projects.
Prompts for V1 must-have features, delayed features, and out-of-scope items.
Produces Markdown PRDs with pain points, user profiles, boundaries, risks, and next steps.
Recommends developer and no-code toolchains for moving from PRD to prototype.
limitations: It does not replace legal, compliance, or professional security advice.
Its output quality depends on the detail and honesty of user answers.
It does not build, test, deploy, or run product code.
Market and competitor guidance may need current external research.

use_cases.title: Shape a Startup Idea
use_cases.description: Turn a rough app or service idea into a first PRD with scope, risk notes, and next actions.

use_cases.title: Run Product Discovery
use_cases.description: Use structured prompts to clarify user value, constraints, competitors, and a practical V1 boundary.

use_cases.title: Plan a Buildable MVP
use_cases.description: Convert side-project notes into a build plan with feature priorities and suitable tool recommendations.

prompt_templates.title: Start Discovery
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner user has a vague idea.
prompt_templates.prompt: I have a rough product idea: [idea]. Ask me the first questions and help me explain the problem, audience, and first screen.

prompt_templates.title: Define MVP Scope
prompt_templates.scenario: User needs a smaller first version.
prompt_templates.prompt: Help me define the V1 boundary for this idea: [idea]. Limit must-have features to three and list what should wait.

prompt_templates.title: Review Risks
prompt_templates.scenario: User needs feasibility and risk feedback.
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this product idea for technical, compliance, safety, cost, and operations risks: [idea]. Explain the risks in plain language.

prompt_templates.title: Generate Final PRD
prompt_templates.scenario: User has completed discovery and wants a deliverable.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use our conversation to create the final PRD. Include scope, user value, risks, competitors, next steps, and tool recommendations.

output_examples.input: I want a walking route app for parents with strollers.
output: Clarifies the target parent, route conditions, and first use case.
Suggests a small V1 focused on saved routes and stroller-friendly notes.
Flags location privacy, map accuracy, and user-generated content risks.

output_examples.input: I need a PRD for a personal finance habit tracker.
output: Defines the core habit loop and the first three required features.
Separates later features such as bank sync and social sharing.
Adds finance data, privacy, and retention risk reminders.

output_examples.input: Help me decide if this marketplace idea is too large for a solo builder.
output: Compares lightweight, medium, and full build paths.
Identifies the main operational burden and trust requirements.
Recommends a narrow prototype before building full marketplace workflows.

best_practices: Answer the discovery questions with concrete users, scenes, and constraints.
Keep the first version to three must-have features before asking for the PRD.
Review risk notes with qualified experts when the idea involves regulated data or safety.
anti_patterns: Do not ask it to validate a market without providing real audience or competitor context.
Do not treat the generated PRD as legal, security, or financial advice.
Do not expand the V1 scope every time a new feature idea appears.

faq.question: Who is Daedalus for?
faq.answer: It is for founders, product managers, creators, and developers who need to turn early ideas into clear PRDs.

faq.question: Does it create a complete PRD?
faq.answer: Yes. It can produce a Markdown PRD with scope, users, risks, competitors, next steps, and tool recommendations.

faq.question: Can non-technical users use it?
faq.answer: Yes. The skill explains choices in plain language and can recommend no-code or AI-friendly tools.

faq.question: Does it perform current market research?
faq.answer: No. It can structure competitor thinking, but current market facts should be checked with external research.

faq.question: Can it replace legal or security review?
faq.answer: No. It can flag common risks, but regulated or sensitive products need qualified professional review.

faq.question: Which tools can use this skill?
faq.answer: The report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.
